affiliations.lab: Institute of Information Technology, University of Dhaka
work: Developed [NavA11y](/project/nava11y), published as a full paper at ENASE 2026.
Constructed and released a 22-page labeled focus-behavior dataset.
Ran a manual validation study with two independent expert raters (90% precision confirmed).
Building [RepairA11y](/project/repaira11y), an LLM-driven repair pipeline for WCAG 2.4 violations that compares runtime-evidence and static-evidence prompting (M.Sc. thesis, in progress).
Built a programming language-specific tokenizer to improve NLP model predictions for software engineering tasks.
